critical_code_review_comments: Minor: POST /api/stories response does not echo voice_id (returned null in create response), though it is correctly persisted in DB and shown by GET /api/stories/{id}. Not user-facing but worth returning for client echo.

Audio element is created via new Audio() and lives outside the DOM; this makes blackbox automation harder but is a valid choice for performance. Consider exposing a window-level ref in dev mode for easier QA, or mount a hidden <audio> element with ref — would also simplify a11y.

context_for_next_testing_agent: To assert audio playback, instrument window.Audio BEFORE page load via page.add_init_script (StoryCarousel uses `new Audio()` so no <audio> appears in DOM). Autoplay still needs a user gesture; a single click on the slide/counter is enough. Core narration arrives within ~1-3s of preview_ready; bonus narration can take ~60s. Public GET endpoint for slug: /api/stories/slug/{slug}; by id: /api/stories/{id}.
